## Clean Trap Level Data 
```{r - trap-level data cleaning}
trapping_data_2 <- new_trapping_data %>%
  filter(type == "BG") %>%
  filter(successful == TRUE) %>%
  filter(collected_at <= "2020-03-31") %>%
  filter(screening_total_aeg > 0) %>%
  mutate(area = substr(trap_id, 1, 3)) %>%
  filter(area != "TUB") %>%
  mutate(collected_at = as.Date(collected_at, format = "%Y/%m/%d"),
         total_aegypti_caught = as.numeric(total_aegypti_caught), 
         screening_total_aeg = as.numeric(screening_total_aeg), 
         screening_wmel_aeg = as.numeric(screening_wmel_aeg), 
         trap_wmel_prev = screening_wmel_aeg/screening_total_aeg, 
         extrap_wmel = floor(trap_wmel_prev*total_aegypti_caught), 
         week = week(collected_at), 
         year = year(collected_at), 
         week.date = floor_date(collected_at, unit = 'week')) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(trap_id, week.date) %>%
  mutate(trapping_events = n()) %>%
  summarize(tot_aegypti = sum(total_aegypti_caught, na.rm = T), 
            tot_aeg_screened = sum(screening_total_aeg, na.rm = T), 
            tot_wmel_screened = sum(screening_wmel_aeg, na.rm = T), 
            trap_avg_wmel_prev = mean(trap_wmel_prev, na.rm = T), 
            trap_events = mean(trapping_events, na.rm = T), 
            tot_wmel = sum(extrap_wmel, na.rm = T), 
            reporting_area, 
            latitude, 
            longitude) %>%
  mutate(norm_tot_aegypti = tot_aegypti/trap_events) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
    mutate(year = year(week.date), 
           week = week(week.date)) %>%
  distinct(trap_id, week.date, .keep_all = T)


weekly_trapping_data_sf <- st_as_sf(trapping_data_2, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = st_crs("+proj=utm +zone=23 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs")) 

#saveRDS(weekly_trapping_data_sf, "data/new_weekly_trapping_data_sf.rds")  

```

## Get Mosquitoes Released in the 100m Area
```{r - release join}
trapping_data_geom <- weekly_trapping_data_sf %>%
  dplyr::select(trap_id, geometry) %>%
  distinct(trap_id, .keep_all = T)

## Create Circles
# circles with radius 100m
circles <- st_buffer(trapping_data_geom, dist = 100)
circles_sf <- st_as_sf(circles)

## get distinct release points
new_release_data_2 <- st_as_sf(new_release_data, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = st_crs("+proj=utm +zone=23 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs")) %>%
  filter(date_of_release <= "2020-03-31")

# side data frame to get each release location 
release_data_2 <- new_release_data_2 %>%
  filter(type_of_release == "Adult") #%>%
 # dplyr::select(identifier, longitude, latitude) %>%
  #distinct(identifier, .keep_all = T)

new_release_data_3 <- st_as_sf(release_data_2, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = st_crs("+proj=utm +zone=23 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"))

## check to make sure release points and circles overlap
ggplot()+
  geom_sf(data = circles_sf$geometry)+
  geom_sf(data = new_release_data_3$geometry)+
  theme_bw()
  
## Combine releases with trap circles
# count # release points in each circle
rp <- st_join(circles_sf, release_data_2, join = st_contains) 
rp_2 <- as.data.frame(rp) %>%
  dplyr::select(-(geometry)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-(type_of_release)) %>%
  mutate(week.date = floor_date(date_of_release, unit = 'week')) %>%
  group_by(week.date, trap_id) %>%
  summarize(mozzies_rel = sum(average_released, na.rm = T), 
            n_release_points = n()) %>%
  group_by(trap_id) %>%
  arrange(week.date) %>%
  mutate(mozzies_rel = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel), 0, mozzies_rel), 
         mozzies_rel_plus1 = mozzies_rel+1,
         mozzies_rel_lag1 = lag(mozzies_rel, 1), 
         mozzies_rel_lag1 = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel_lag1), 0, mozzies_rel_lag1),
         mozzies_rel_plus1_lag1 = lag(mozzies_rel_plus1, 1),
         mozzies_rel_lag2 = lag(mozzies_rel, 2),
         mozzies_rel_lag2 = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel_lag2), 0, mozzies_rel_lag2),
         mozzies_rel_plus1_lag2 = lag(mozzies_rel_plus1, 2),
         mozzies_rel_lag3 = lag(mozzies_rel, 3), 
         mozzies_rel_lag3 = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel_lag3), 0, mozzies_rel_lag3),
         mozzies_rel_plus1_lag3 = lag(mozzies_rel_plus1, 3),
         mozzies_rel_lag4 = lag(mozzies_rel, 4), 
         mozzies_rel_lag4 = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel_lag4), 0, mozzies_rel_lag4),
         mozzies_rel_plus1_lag4 = lag(mozzies_rel_plus1, 4),
         mozzies_rel_lag5 = lag(mozzies_rel, 5), 
         mozzies_rel_lag5 = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel_lag5), 0, mozzies_rel_lag5),
         mozzies_rel_plus1_lag5 = lag(mozzies_rel_plus1, 5),
         mozzies_rel_lag6 = lag(mozzies_rel, 6), 
         mozzies_rel_lag6 = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel_lag6), 0, mozzies_rel_lag6),
         mozzies_rel_plus1_lag6 = lag(mozzies_rel_plus1, 6),
         mozzies_rel_lag7 = lag(mozzies_rel, 7), 
         mozzies_rel_lag7 = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel_lag7), 0, mozzies_rel_lag7),
         mozzies_rel_plus1_lag7 = lag(mozzies_rel_plus1, 7),
         mozzies_rel_lag8 = lag(mozzies_rel, 8), 
         mozzies_rel_lag8 = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel_lag8), 0, mozzies_rel_lag8), 
         mozzies_rel_plus1_lag8 = lag(mozzies_rel_plus1, 8)) %>%
  ungroup() 

## get first release date
rel_first <- rp_2 %>%
  filter(mozzies_rel > 0) %>%
  group_by(trap_id) %>%
  mutate(n = row_number(), 
         first_rel_date = if_else(n == 1, week.date, NA), 
         full_first_rel_date = mean(first_rel_date, na.rm = T),
         t_since_first_rel = difftime(week.date, full_first_rel_date, units = "weeks"), 
         t_since_first_rel = as.numeric(t_since_first_rel)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(week.date, trap_id, t_since_first_rel) 

rp_3 <- left_join(rp_2, rel_first, by = c("trap_id" = "trap_id", "week.date" = "week.date"))

## combine trapping and release data
trapping_data_t2 <- full_join(weekly_trapping_data_sf, rp_3,
                                      by = c("trap_id" = "trap_id", 
                                             "week.date" = "week.date"))

## filter out releases without trapping
trapping_data_t3 <- trapping_data_t2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(tot_aegypti)) %>%
  mutate(tot_wmel = if_else(tot_aegypti == 0, 0, tot_wmel)) %>%
    mutate(release_zone = if_else(grepl('RJ1', trap_id), "RJ1", "NA"), 
         release_zone = if_else(grepl('RJ2', trap_id), "RJ2", release_zone), 
         release_zone = if_else(grepl('RJ3.B1', trap_id) | 
                                  grepl('RJ3.V1', trap_id), "RJ3.1", release_zone),
         release_zone = if_else(grepl('RJ3.B2', trap_id) | 
                                  grepl('RJ3.V2', trap_id), "RJ3.2", release_zone),
         release_zone = if_else(grepl('RJ3.B3', trap_id) | 
                                  grepl('RJ3.V3', trap_id), "RJ3.3", release_zone), 
         release_zone = as.factor(release_zone))


#saveRDS(trapping_data_t3, "data/new_trapping_data_t3.rds")


```

## Trap Level Model Set-Up
```{r - model set-up}
trap_model_df <- trapping_data_t3 %>%
  mutate(trap_id = as.factor(trap_id), 
         release_zone = as.factor(release_zone)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(week.date) %>%
  group_by(trap_id) %>%
  mutate(wmel_prev_lag1 = lag(trap_avg_wmel_prev, 1), 
         wmel_prev_lag2 = lag(trap_avg_wmel_prev, 2), 
         wmel_prev_lag3 = lag(trap_avg_wmel_prev, 3), 
         wmel_prev_lag4 = lag(trap_avg_wmel_prev, 4),
         wmel_prev_lag5 = lag(trap_avg_wmel_prev, 5),
         wmel_prev_lag6 = lag(trap_avg_wmel_prev, 6),
         wmel_prev_lag7 = lag(trap_avg_wmel_prev, 7),
         wmel_prev_lag8 = lag(trap_avg_wmel_prev, 8), 
         log_mozzies_rel = log(mozzies_rel), 
         log_mozzies_rel = if_else(log_mozzies_rel == -Inf, 0, log_mozzies_rel), 
         log_mozzies_rel_lag1 = log(mozzies_rel_lag1), 
         log_mozzies_rel_lag1 = if_else(log_mozzies_rel_lag1 == -Inf, 0, log_mozzies_rel_lag1), 
         log_mozzies_rel_lag2 = log(mozzies_rel_lag2), 
         log_mozzies_rel_lag2 = if_else(log_mozzies_rel_lag2 == -Inf, 0, log_mozzies_rel_lag2),
         log_mozzies_rel_lag3 = log(mozzies_rel_lag3), 
         log_mozzies_rel_lag3 = if_else(log_mozzies_rel_lag3 == -Inf, 0, log_mozzies_rel_lag3), 
         log_mozzies_rel_lag4 = log(mozzies_rel_lag4), 
         log_mozzies_rel_lag4 = if_else(log_mozzies_rel_lag4 == -Inf, 0, log_mozzies_rel_lag4), 
         log_mozzies_rel_lag5 = log(mozzies_rel_lag5), 
         log_mozzies_rel_lag5 = if_else(log_mozzies_rel_lag5 == -Inf, 0, log_mozzies_rel_lag5), 
         log_mozzies_rel_lag6 = log(mozzies_rel_lag6), 
         log_mozzies_rel_lag6 = if_else(log_mozzies_rel_lag6 == -Inf, 0, log_mozzies_rel_lag6), 
         log_mozzies_rel_lag7 = log(mozzies_rel_lag7), 
         log_mozzies_rel_lag7 = if_else(log_mozzies_rel_lag7 == -Inf, 0, log_mozzies_rel_lag7), 
         log_mozzies_rel_lag8 = log(mozzies_rel_lag8), 
         log_mozzies_rel_lag8 = if_else(log_mozzies_rel_lag8 == -Inf, 0, log_mozzies_rel_lag8), 
         log_tot_aegypti = log(tot_aegypti), 
         log_tot_aegypti = if_else(log_tot_aegypti == -Inf, 0, log_tot_aegypti), 
         log_tot_aegypti_lag1 = lag(log_tot_aegypti, 1),
         log_tot_aegypti_lag2 = lag(log_tot_aegypti, 2),
         log_tot_aegypti_lag3 = lag(log_tot_aegypti, 3),
         log_tot_aegypti_lag4 = lag(log_tot_aegypti, 4),
         log_tot_aegypti_lag5 = lag(log_tot_aegypti, 5),
         log_tot_aegypti_lag6 = lag(log_tot_aegypti, 6),
         log_tot_aegypti_lag7 = lag(log_tot_aegypti, 7),
         log_tot_aegypti_lag8 = lag(log_tot_aegypti, 8)) %>%
  ungroup() 

#saveRDS(trap_model_df, "data/trap_model_df.rds")

```


## Set Up Covariates 
#### Population

```{r}
pop <- covariate_gbmt %>%
  dplyr::select(trap_id, pop_sum)
# pop_circles <- exact_extract(pop, circles_sf, fun = "sum", append_cols = "trap_id", progress = FALSE) |> 
#   rename(pop_sum = sum)
```

#### Elevation

```{r}
 elv_circles <- exact_extract(elevation, circles_sf, fun = "mean", append_cols = "trap_id", progress = FALSE) |> 
   rename(elev = mean)
```

#### Urban green space

```{r}
 ugs_circles <- exact_extract(ugs, circles_sf, fun = "sum", append_cols = "trap_id", progress = FALSE) |>
   mutate(ugs_m = sum*10,
          ugs_perc = ugs_m/(pi*100^2)*100) |>
   dplyr::select(-sum)
```

#### Impervious surface

```{r}
 imperv_perc <- terra::classify(imperv, rbind(c(200, NA), c(255, NA)))
# 
 imperv_circles <- exact_extract(imperv_perc, circles_sf, fun = "mean", append_cols = "trap_id", progress = FALSE) |> 
   rename(imperv_perc = mean)
```

#### Land surface temperature

```{r}
 lst_circles <- exact_extract(lst, circles_sf, fun = "mean", append_cols = "trap_id", progress = FALSE) |> 
   rename(lst = mean)
```

#### Census

```{r}
 census2 <- st_join(circles_sf, census, join = st_intersects)
# 
 census3 <- census2 |>
   st_drop_geometry() |>
   group_by(trap_id) |>
   summarise(prop_minwage = mean(prop_minwage, na.rm = TRUE),
             mean_income = mean(mean_income, na.rm = TRUE),
             prop_hhminwage = mean(prop_hhminwage, na.rm = TRUE),
             hhmean_income = mean(hhmean_income, na.rm = TRUE))
```

#### Join all

```{r}
trap_model_df_2 <- trap_model_df  |> 
   left_join(pop, by = "trap_id") |>
   left_join(elv_circles, by = "trap_id") |>
   left_join(ugs_circles, by = "trap_id") |>
   left_join(imperv_circles, by = "trap_id") |>
   left_join(lst_circles, by = "trap_id") |>
   left_join(census3, by = "trap_id")
# 
 #saveRDS(trap_model_df_2, "data/trap_model_df_2.rds")
```

## Get Mozzies Rel Lag 0
```{r - mozzies_rel_lag0}
trapping_data_lag0 <- new_trapping_data %>%
  filter(type == "BG") %>%
  filter(successful == TRUE) %>%
  filter(collected_at <= "2020-03-31") %>%
  filter(screening_total_aeg > 0) %>%
  mutate(area = substr(trap_id, 1, 3)) %>%
  filter(area != "TUB") %>%
  mutate(collected_at = as.Date(collected_at, format = "%Y/%m/%d"),
         total_aegypti_caught = as.numeric(total_aegypti_caught), 
         screening_total_aeg = as.numeric(screening_total_aeg), 
         screening_wmel_aeg = as.numeric(screening_wmel_aeg), 
         trap_wmel_prev = screening_wmel_aeg/screening_total_aeg, 
         extrap_wmel = floor(trap_wmel_prev*total_aegypti_caught), 
         week = week(collected_at), 
         year = year(collected_at), 
         week.date = floor_date(collected_at, unit = 'week')) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(trap_id, week.date) %>%
  mutate(trapping_events = n()) %>%
  mutate(tot_aegypti = sum(total_aegypti_caught, na.rm = T), 
            tot_aeg_screened = sum(screening_total_aeg, na.rm = T), 
            tot_wmel_screened = sum(screening_wmel_aeg, na.rm = T), 
            trap_avg_wmel_prev = mean(trap_wmel_prev, na.rm = T), 
            trap_events = mean(trapping_events, na.rm = T), 
            tot_wmel = sum(extrap_wmel, na.rm = T), 
            reporting_area, 
            latitude, 
            longitude) %>%
  mutate(norm_tot_aegypti = tot_aegypti/trap_events) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
    mutate(year = year(week.date), 
           week = week(week.date)) %>%
  distinct(trap_id, collected_at, .keep_all = T)

trapping_data_lag0_sf <- st_as_sf(trapping_data_lag0, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = st_crs("+proj=utm +zone=23 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs")) 

trapping_data_geom_lag0 <- trapping_data_lag0_sf %>%
  dplyr::select(trap_id, geometry) %>%
  distinct(trap_id, .keep_all = T)

circles_lag0 <- st_buffer(trapping_data_geom_lag0, dist = 100)
circles_sf_lag0 <- st_as_sf(circles_lag0)


## lag 0
## Combine releases with trap circles
# count # release points in each circle
rp_lag0 <- st_join(circles_sf_lag0, release_data_2, join = st_contains) 
rp_2_lag0 <- as.data.frame(rp_lag0) %>%
  group_by(date_of_release, trap_id) %>%
  summarize(mozzies_rel_lag0.1 = sum(average_released, na.rm = T), 
            n_release_points = n()) %>%
  group_by(trap_id) %>%
  arrange(date_of_release) %>%
  mutate(mozzies_rel_lag0.1 = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel_lag0.1), 0, mozzies_rel_lag0.1)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(week.date = floor_date(date_of_release, unit = 'week')) 

## combine trapping and release data
trapping_data_t2_lag0 <- full_join(trapping_data_lag0_sf, rp_2_lag0,
                                      by = c("trap_id" = "trap_id", 
                                             "week.date" = "week.date"))

## filter out releases without trapping
trapping_data_t3_lag0 <- trapping_data_t2_lag0 %>%
  filter(!is.na(tot_aegypti)) %>%
  mutate(tot_wmel = if_else(tot_aegypti == 0, 0, tot_wmel)) %>%
    mutate(release_zone = if_else(grepl('RJ1', trap_id), "RJ1", "NA"), 
         release_zone = if_else(grepl('RJ2', trap_id), "RJ2", release_zone), 
         release_zone = if_else(grepl('RJ3.B1', trap_id) | 
                                  grepl('RJ3.V1', trap_id), "RJ3.1", release_zone),
         release_zone = if_else(grepl('RJ3.B2', trap_id) | 
                                  grepl('RJ3.V2', trap_id), "RJ3.2", release_zone),
         release_zone = if_else(grepl('RJ3.B3', trap_id) | 
                                  grepl('RJ3.V3', trap_id), "RJ3.3", release_zone), 
         release_zone = as.factor(release_zone))

trapping_data_t4_lag0 <- as.data.frame(trapping_data_t3_lag0) %>%
  mutate(mozzies_rel_lag0 = if_else(date_of_release <= collected_at, mozzies_rel_lag0.1, 0)) %>%
  group_by(trap_id, week.date) %>%
  summarize(mozzies_rel_lag0 = sum(mozzies_rel_lag0, na.rm = T)) %>%
  ungroup()

mozzies_rel_lag0_df <- trapping_data_t4_lag0 %>%
  mutate(mozzies_rel_lag0_nz = if_else(mozzies_rel_lag0 == 0, NA_real_, mozzies_rel_lag0), 
         mozzies_rel_lag0_binary = if_else(mozzies_rel_lag0 == 0, 0, 1))
```

## 50m radius
```{r - 50m radius}

## Create Circles
# circles with radius 100m
circles_50 <- st_buffer(trapping_data_geom, dist = 50)
circles_50_sf <- st_as_sf(circles_50)

## get distinct release points
new_release_data_2 <- st_as_sf(new_release_data, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = st_crs("+proj=utm +zone=23 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs")) %>%
  filter(date_of_release <= "2020-03-31")

# side data frame to get each release location 
release_data_2 <- new_release_data_2 %>%
  filter(type_of_release == "Adult") 

new_release_data_3 <- st_as_sf(release_data_2, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = st_crs("+proj=utm +zone=23 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"))
  
## Combine releases with trap circles
# count # release points in each circle
rp_50 <- st_join(circles_50_sf, release_data_2, join = st_contains) 
rp_50_2 <- as.data.frame(rp_50) %>%
  dplyr::select(-(geometry)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-(type_of_release)) %>%
  mutate(week.date = floor_date(date_of_release, unit = 'week')) %>%
  group_by(week.date, trap_id) %>%
  summarize(mozzies_rel = sum(average_released, na.rm = T), 
            n_release_points = n()) %>%
  group_by(trap_id) %>%
  arrange(week.date) %>%
  mutate(mozzies_rel = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel), 0, mozzies_rel), 
         mozzies_rel_plus1 = mozzies_rel+1,
         mozzies_rel_lag1 = lag(mozzies_rel, 1), 
         mozzies_rel_lag1 = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel_lag1), 0, mozzies_rel_lag1),
         mozzies_rel_plus1_lag1 = lag(mozzies_rel_plus1, 1),
         mozzies_rel_lag2 = lag(mozzies_rel, 2),
         mozzies_rel_lag2 = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel_lag2), 0, mozzies_rel_lag2),
         mozzies_rel_plus1_lag2 = lag(mozzies_rel_plus1, 2),
         mozzies_rel_lag3 = lag(mozzies_rel, 3), 
         mozzies_rel_lag3 = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel_lag3), 0, mozzies_rel_lag3),
         mozzies_rel_plus1_lag3 = lag(mozzies_rel_plus1, 3),
         mozzies_rel_lag4 = lag(mozzies_rel, 4), 
         mozzies_rel_lag4 = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel_lag4), 0, mozzies_rel_lag4),
         mozzies_rel_plus1_lag4 = lag(mozzies_rel_plus1, 4),
         mozzies_rel_lag5 = lag(mozzies_rel, 5), 
         mozzies_rel_lag5 = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel_lag5), 0, mozzies_rel_lag5),
         mozzies_rel_plus1_lag5 = lag(mozzies_rel_plus1, 5),
         mozzies_rel_lag6 = lag(mozzies_rel, 6), 
         mozzies_rel_lag6 = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel_lag6), 0, mozzies_rel_lag6),
         mozzies_rel_plus1_lag6 = lag(mozzies_rel_plus1, 6),
         mozzies_rel_lag7 = lag(mozzies_rel, 7), 
         mozzies_rel_lag7 = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel_lag7), 0, mozzies_rel_lag7),
         mozzies_rel_plus1_lag7 = lag(mozzies_rel_plus1, 7),
         mozzies_rel_lag8 = lag(mozzies_rel, 8), 
         mozzies_rel_lag8 = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel_lag8), 0, mozzies_rel_lag8), 
         mozzies_rel_plus1_lag8 = lag(mozzies_rel_plus1, 8)) %>%
  ungroup() 

## get first release date
rel_first_50 <- rp_50_2 %>%
  filter(mozzies_rel > 0) %>%
  group_by(trap_id) %>%
  mutate(n = row_number(), 
         first_rel_date = if_else(n == 1, week.date, NA), 
         full_first_rel_date = mean(first_rel_date, na.rm = T),
         t_since_first_rel = difftime(week.date, full_first_rel_date, units = "weeks"), 
         t_since_first_rel = as.numeric(t_since_first_rel)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(week.date, trap_id, t_since_first_rel) 

rp_50_3 <- left_join(rp_50_2, rel_first_50, by = c("trap_id" = "trap_id", "week.date" = "week.date"))

## combine trapping and release data

## Month and Season of First Release Covariates
sp_temp_full_df_50 <- trap_model_50_df_2 %>%
  mutate(epiyear = epiyear(week.date), 
         epiweek = epiweek(week.date)) %>%
  left_join(meteo_week_3, by = c("epiyear" = "year", 
                                  "epiweek" = "week")) |>
  arrange(week.date) %>%
  mutate(month = month(week.date),
    season = if_else(month >= 5 & month <= 10, 
                            "Dry Season", "Rainy Season"))


## trapping data
trapping_data_lag0 <- new_trapping_data %>%
  filter(type == "BG") %>%
  filter(successful == TRUE) %>%
  filter(collected_at <= "2020-03-31") %>%
  filter(screening_total_aeg > 0) %>%
  mutate(area = substr(trap_id, 1, 3)) %>%
  filter(area != "TUB") %>%
  mutate(collected_at = as.Date(collected_at, format = "%Y/%m/%d"),
         total_aegypti_caught = as.numeric(total_aegypti_caught), 
         screening_total_aeg = as.numeric(screening_total_aeg), 
         screening_wmel_aeg = as.numeric(screening_wmel_aeg), 
         trap_wmel_prev = screening_wmel_aeg/screening_total_aeg, 
         extrap_wmel = floor(trap_wmel_prev*total_aegypti_caught), 
         week = week(collected_at), 
         year = year(collected_at), 
         week.date = floor_date(collected_at, unit = 'week')) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(trap_id, week.date) %>%
  mutate(trapping_events = n()) %>%
  mutate(tot_aegypti = sum(total_aegypti_caught, na.rm = T), 
            tot_aeg_screened = sum(screening_total_aeg, na.rm = T), 
            tot_wmel_screened = sum(screening_wmel_aeg, na.rm = T), 
            trap_avg_wmel_prev = mean(trap_wmel_prev, na.rm = T), 
            trap_events = mean(trapping_events, na.rm = T), 
            tot_wmel = sum(extrap_wmel, na.rm = T), 
            reporting_area, 
            latitude, 
            longitude) %>%
  mutate(norm_tot_aegypti = tot_aegypti/trap_events) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
    mutate(year = year(week.date), 
           week = week(week.date)) %>%
  distinct(trap_id, collected_at, .keep_all = T)

trapping_data_lag0_sf <- st_as_sf(trapping_data_lag0, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = st_crs("+proj=utm +zone=23 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs")) 

trapping_data_geom_lag0 <- trapping_data_lag0_sf %>%

circles_lag0_50 <- st_buffer(trapping_data_geom_lag0, dist = 50)

## combine trapping and release data

sp_temp_full_50 <- sp_temp_full_df_50_3

saveRDS(sp_temp_full_50, "data/sp_temp_full_50.rds")
```

```{r - 50m radius}
  mutate(collected_at = as.Date(collected_at, format = "%Y/%m/%d"),
         total_aegypti_caught = as.numeric(total_aegypti_caught), 
         screening_total_aeg = as.numeric(screening_total_aeg),

         trap_wmel_prev = screening_wmel_aeg/screening_total_aeg, 
         extrap_wmel = floor(trap_wmel_prev*total_aegypti_caught), 
         week = week(collected_at),

         week.date = floor_date(collected_at, unit = 'week')) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(trap_id, week.date) %>%
  mutate(trapping_events = n()) %>%
  mutate(tot_aegypti = sum(total_aegypti_caught, na.rm = T),

            reporting_area, 
            latitude, 
            longitude) %>%

## Combine releases with trap circles
```

```{r - vehicle releases}
rp_v <- st_join(circles_sf, release_data_v, join = st_contains) 
rp_2v <- as.data.frame(rp_v) %>%

  group_by(trap_id) %>%
  arrange(week.date) %>%
  mutate(mozzies_rel = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel), 0, mozzies_rel), 
         mozzies_rel_plus1 = mozzies_rel+1,
         mozzies_rel_lag1 = lag(mozzies_rel, 1), 
         mozzies_rel_lag1 = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel_lag1), 0, mozzies_rel_lag1),
         mozzies_rel_plus1_lag1 = lag(mozzies_rel_plus1, 1),
         mozzies_rel_lag2 = lag(mozzies_rel, 2),
         mozzies_rel_lag2 = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel_lag2), 0, mozzies_rel_lag2),
         mozzies_rel_plus1_lag2 = lag(mozzies_rel_plus1, 2),
         mozzies_rel_lag3 = lag(mozzies_rel, 3), 
         mozzies_rel_lag3 = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel_lag3), 0, mozzies_rel_lag3),
         mozzies_rel_plus1_lag3 = lag(mozzies_rel_plus1, 3),
         mozzies_rel_lag4 = lag(mozzies_rel, 4), 
         mozzies_rel_lag4 = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel_lag4), 0, mozzies_rel_lag4),
         mozzies_rel_plus1_lag4 = lag(mozzies_rel_plus1, 4),
         mozzies_rel_lag5 = lag(mozzies_rel, 5), 
         mozzies_rel_lag5 = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel_lag5), 0, mozzies_rel_lag5),
         mozzies_rel_plus1_lag5 = lag(mozzies_rel_plus1, 5),
         mozzies_rel_lag6 = lag(mozzies_rel, 6), 
         mozzies_rel_lag6 = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel_lag6), 0, mozzies_rel_lag6),
         mozzies_rel_plus1_lag6 = lag(mozzies_rel_plus1, 6),
         mozzies_rel_lag7 = lag(mozzies_rel, 7), 
         mozzies_rel_lag7 = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel_lag7), 0, mozzies_rel_lag7),
         mozzies_rel_plus1_lag7 = lag(mozzies_rel_plus1, 7),
         mozzies_rel_lag8 = lag(mozzies_rel, 8), 
         mozzies_rel_lag8 = if_else(is.na(mozzies_rel_lag8), 0, mozzies_rel_lag8), 
         mozzies_rel_plus1_lag8 = lag(mozzies_rel_plus1, 8)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(release_t = "vehicle")

## get first release date
rel_first_v <- rp_2v %>%
  filter(mozzies_rel > 0) %>%
  group_by(trap_id) %>%
  mutate(n = row_number(), 
         first_rel_date = if_else(n == 1, week.date, NA), 
         full_first_rel_date = mean(first_rel_date, na.rm = T),
         t_since_first_rel = difftime(week.date, full_first_rel_date, units = "weeks"), 
         t_since_first_rel = as.numeric(t_since_first_rel)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(week.date, trap_id, t_since_first_rel)

## trapping data
trapping_data_lag0 <- new_trapping_data %>%
  filter(type == "BG") %>%
  filter(successful == TRUE) %>%
  filter(collected_at <= "2020-03-31") %>%
  filter(screening_total_aeg > 0) %>%
  mutate(area = substr(trap_id, 1, 3)) %>%
  filter(area != "TUB") %>%
  mutate(collected_at = as.Date(collected_at, format = "%Y/%m/%d"),
         total_aegypti_caught = as.numeric(total_aegypti_caught), 
         screening_total_aeg = as.numeric(screening_total_aeg), 
         screening_wmel_aeg = as.numeric(screening_wmel_aeg), 
         trap_wmel_prev = screening_wmel_aeg/screening_total_aeg, 
         extrap_wmel = floor(trap_wmel_prev*total_aegypti_caught), 
         week = week(collected_at), 
         year = year(collected_at), 
         week.date = floor_date(collected_at, unit = 'week')) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(trap_id, week.date) %>%
  mutate(trapping_events = n()) %>%
  mutate(tot_aegypti = sum(total_aegypti_caught, na.rm = T), 
            tot_aeg_screened = sum(screening_total_aeg, na.rm = T), 
            tot_wmel_screened = sum(screening_wmel_aeg, na.rm = T), 
            trap_avg_wmel_prev = mean(trap_wmel_prev, na.rm = T), 
            trap_events = mean(trapping_events, na.rm = T), 
            tot_wmel = sum(extrap_wmel, na.rm = T), 
            reporting_area, 
            latitude, 
            longitude) %>%
  mutate(norm_tot_aegypti = tot_aegypti/trap_events) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
    mutate(year = year(week.date), 
           week = week(week.date)) %>%
  distinct(trap_id, collected_at, .keep_all = T)

trapping_data_lag0_sf <- st_as_sf(trapping_data_lag0, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = st_crs("+proj=utm +zone=23 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"))

sp_temp_full_df_3v <- sp_temp_full_df_8v %>%
  mutate(t_year = if_else(year == 2017, 1, NA), 
         t_year = if_else(year == 2018, 2, t_year), 
         t_year = if_else(year == 2019, 3, t_year), 
         t_year = if_else(year == 2020, 4, t_year), 
      t_season = if_else(season == "Dry Season" & year == 2017, 1, NA), 
      t_season = if_else(season == "Rainy Season" & year == 2017, 2, t_year),
      t_season = if_else(season == "Dry Season" & year == 2018, 3, t_year),
      t_season = if_else(season == "Rainy Season" & year == 2018, 4, t_year),
      t_season = if_else(season == "Dry Season" & year == 2019, 5, t_year),
      t_season = if_else(season == "Rainy Season" & year == 2019, 6, t_year),
      t_season = if_else(season == "Dry Season" & year == 2020, 7, t_year),
      t_season = if_else(season == "Rainy Season" & year == 2020, 8, t_year))

sp_temp_full_v <- sp_temp_full_df_3v

saveRDS(sp_temp_full_v, "data/sp_temp_full_v.rds")

```
